definitions.gloss: peashooter; pea gun (toy that shoots beans)
definitions.explanation: A simple toy gun, traditionally bamboo, that fires small beans or pellets. Mostly encountered today in the idiom {鳩|はと}が{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}を{食|く}ったよう.

examples.japanese: {豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}で{遊|あそ}んだ。
{鳩|はと}が{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}を{食|く}ったような{顔|かお}をした。
examples.english: He looked like a pigeon hit by a peashooter — i.e., stunned and wide-eyed.

examples.japanese: {突然|とつぜん}の{知|し}らせに、{彼女|かのじょ}は{鳩|はと}が{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}を{食|く}ったような{顔|かお}でこちらを{見|み}つめた。
examples.english: At the sudden news, she stared at me with a stunned, wide-eyed look.

notes:
Compound of {豆|まめ} (bean) + {鉄砲|てっぽう} (gun), with rendaku turning てっぽう into でっぽう. The literal toy is rarely seen today; the word survives mainly in one famous idiom.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {鳩|はと}が{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}を{食|く}ったよう: looking startled and dumbfounded, eyes wide open — the image is of a pigeon hit by a sudden tiny shot and frozen in surprise. This is far and away the most common way the word appears in modern Japanese.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水鉄砲|みずでっぽう}: water gun — similar construction with a different ammo
- おもちゃの{銃|じゅう}: toy gun — modern, generic equivalent
